name: Coldtooth Supplies
label: Quest
description: Coldtooth Supplies: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Coldtooth mine is a storage depot for the Horde. I can't stomach the food they give their troops, and the state of their arms and armor is atrocious! But... In times like these when supplies are so important, we can use what they have.
Enter the Coldtooth mine and bring me back their supplies. That will help keep the Alliance in fighting shape, and remove much needed equipment from the Horde's warriors.
Good luck, friend. The mine is to the distant south, deep in Horde territory.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you enter the Coldtooth mine in Horde territory, friend? Did you raid their supplies?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, you got them. Good work, friend! These supplies are a little musty from sitting in that dark mine for so long, but we'll make use of them nonetheless.
Thank you, friend. Your deeds are vital to the maintenance of our fighting forces.
